_about: Season cycle: operate during transfer windows, holiday otherwise. Window dates are approximate (MM-DD); check the in-game calendar.

holiday.return: after N days via 'Return from vacation after'; for a season: back on 05-28 (after the last league match, before the summer window)
holiday.offers: Only accept offers matching asking price
holiday._never_tick: Forcing the XI stops the assistant rotating tired players and causes injuries (user rule).
